playstyle: Five fragile Chaos marauders with uniform Move 4 but only three or four wounds and weak saves apiece. Their engine runs on slaughter: each enemy slain inspires friendly fighters equal to that target's Bounty, so every takedown snowballs the survivors. Reactions layer on extra Attack dice, free Charges and Cleave against vulnerable targets, turning one kill into a chain of escalating pressure. The warband wins by charging hard and early, converting raw aggression into an inspired, buffed fighting force before the opponent can stabilize.
